svg.title: Foundry worker — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as foundry worker, wearing a protective coat and a hard hat. Visible work cue: A tipped foundry ladle pours one continuous molten-metal stream into an open mould. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a hard hat.
